visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a static close-up of four colorful, fibrous spheres resembling yarn balls on a white ceramic plate. These are Dragon's Beard candies in shades of lime green, pale yellow, brown, and light pink, set against a blurred indoor background. (2) In a bright studio kitchen, a male chef in a white professional jacket stands next to a host wearing a green shirt and a black apron. Behind them is a large gold logo on a white wall. The setting is professionally lit with bright studio lighting. (3) A wide shot shows the exterior of a clean, white building with "Johnny Yan" and "強尼甜點工藝" text prominently displayed. The scene is captured in natural daylight with a clear, bright atmosphere. (4) Detailed close-up shots showcase different flavored candy balls, some garnished with delicate dried flower petals. The lighting is bright and high-contrast, emphasizing the fine, hair-like texture of the sugar threads. (5) The chef holds a translucent, amber-colored hard sugar disc in one hand and a soft, opaque piece of sugar in the other. He stands in the studio kitchen, demonstrating the raw materials used in his craft. (6) A medium shot captures the chef wearing blue gloves, pulling and stretching a pink mass of sugar within a large tray filled with white cornstarch or flour. A host stands nearby, gesturing and observing with an excited expression. (7) Successive close-up shots focus on the chef's hands as he repeatedly folds and stretches the pink sugar into thousands of fine threads. The camera follows the rhythmic movement as the sugar is coated in white powder. (8) The scene shifts to two other staff members in a separate kitchen area, wearing white shirts, caps, and masks. They work together to pull a significantly larger and heavier mass of white sugar threads around a mechanical post. (9) Hands in blue gloves are seen carefully placing a pinkish powder filling into a small bundle of fine threads. The bundle is then rolled into a neat, cocoon-like shape and placed into a clear plastic container. (10) The video concludes with a static shot of five completed candy balls on a white plate, showcasing a variety of colors and the delicate craftsmanship involved in the process.
